work_experience.name: OMR - Optical Mark Recogniser (Graduation Project)
work_experience.description: AI-powered system for automated exam grading and answer sheet analysis.
highlights: Led a team of 4 developers to design and implement a full-stack OMR system using Angular, NestJS, and MongoDB.
Developed a robust backend API with NestJS, implementing JWT authentication, role-based access control, and RESTful endpoints for user management, exam creation, and result processing.
Built a responsive frontend with Angular and Material-UI, enabling users to upload answer sheets, view results, and manage exams with an intuitive interface.
Integrated OpenCV and Tesseract OCR for accurate text extraction and image processing, achieving high precision in handwritten character recognition.
Optimized database queries and implemented caching strategies to improve system performance and reduce response times for large-scale exam processing.
Conducted thorough testing and debugging, ensuring system reliability and scalability for handling thousands of exam submissions simultaneously.
